args.title: Bellwether Office newsletter — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Bellwether Office's latest issue covers "Warehouse automation in 2026" (links to https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/warehouse).
• Main article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
